title: Validate Time Format HH:MM:SS

content.problemStatement: Write a program to check whether the time is valid or not
content.inputFormat: Accept three integer as a input

solution.approach: Validate time string formatted as HH:MM:SS.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Check 0 <= HH <= 23, 0 <= MM <= 59, 0 <= SS <= 59. Print 'Valid' or 'Not Valid'.

hints: Verify hours is between 0 and 23 inclusive.
Verify minutes and seconds are between 0 and 59 inclusive.
